senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt. of κλινο-βατήριον = βάθριον, corresp. to Lat. scamnum) step placed before the bed.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:7">Y. Ber. III, 5ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>שומט קלבינטרין וכ׳</he> (ed. Lehm. <cite ref="S01894"><he>קרביטין</he></cite>, corr. acc.; Mus. in Ar. ed.
